features: ⚠️ THIS VERSION ADDS NO MIGRATIONS. You can now undo a data import: if you loaded a building and realise the files were wrong, you remove it along with everything that came in with it, instead of deleting entries one by one.

⚠️ WHO CAN IMPORT HAS CHANGED — A new permission is required, «Importa dati» (Import data), which administrators receive automatically on upgrade. If you had delegated importing to a collaborator by giving them «Crea condomini», from this version you must also grant «Importa dati» from their user page.

UNDOING AN IMPORT, WHILE YOU STILL CAN — The button is on the outcome screen, reachable from the building's dashboard. Before asking for confirmation it says what will disappear, counted: the building, the units, the people, the millesimal tables, the opening balances. People stay in your address book if they also belong to another building or have an account. It works for a half-finished import too, which is when it matters most.

THERE IS NO DEADLINE, THERE IS A CONDITION — The question is not when but whether anyone has worked on it: an import nobody has used stays undoable forever, one where you already recorded an invoice is not undoable ten minutes later. When it cannot be done, the screen says what prevents it instead of showing a greyed-out button. Two cases stay out: imports that went into a building that already existed, and uploads never confirmed, which are discarded instead.

AND «WORKED ON» DOES NOT MEAN ONLY ACCOUNTING — An uploaded document, a notice on the board, a calendar event, an open ticket, a comment and contributions already paid also block the undo: they would all disappear together with the building, and none of them came in with the import.

🔒 A FILE FROM SOMEONE ELSE'S IMPORT CAN NO LONGER BE TOUCHED — Two of the twelve import screens did not check who owned the upload: anyone who could import was able to change the type of a colleague's file and delete it, knowing the address. The check the other ten already had is now there too.

TELLING HALF-FINISHED IMPORTS APART — The cards only showed the date and the number of files: with two or three migrations open at once they were indistinguishable. They now carry the building's name, and the file names when the building is not known yet.

DETAILS — The dropdown that corrects a file's type now looks like the rest of the program's dropdowns. The «Lascia stare», «Scarta» and «Togli» buttons now look like buttons. The recognition screen no longer cites a version released months ago. The import guide covers the undo.
